color.note: bm-* are the fixed values of the big-matrix.com design tokens (same names as the site's CSS variables). The unprefixed roles switch with the ground: Ink theme or Paper theme.

tokens.name: bm-accent
tokens.usage: Matrix Red, the one accent: emphasis words, dots, ticks, glows. Large text (24px+, or 19px bold) and graphics only: 4.66:1 on bm-ink, 4.09:1 on bm-paper.

tokens.name: bm-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Red Fill: primary button background with white label (4.83:1).

tokens.name: bm-accent-deep
tokens.usage: Red Deep: button hover, gradient end, and small red text on white (5.71:1 on bm-paper).

tokens.name: bm-accent-on-ink
tokens.usage: Red on Ink: red text and ticks on dark grounds (6.19:1 on bm-ink, 5.38:1 on bm-ink-2).

tokens.name: bm-ink
tokens.usage: Ink: the dark ground. Covers, slides, social posts, website header.

tokens.name: bm-ink-2
tokens.usage: Ink 2: cards and panels on bm-ink.

tokens.name: bm-paper
tokens.usage: Paper: the light ground. Documents, email, white pages.

tokens.name: bm-text
tokens.usage: Graphite: body text on bm-paper (17.04:1).

tokens.name: bm-text-2
tokens.usage: Slate: secondary text on bm-paper (8.32:1).

tokens.name: bm-text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on bm-paper (5.25:1). Never on bm-ink (3.63:1): there, text-3 uses #8F9297.

tokens.name: bm-text-inv
tokens.usage: Mist: headlines and body on bm-ink (16.99:1) and bm-ink-2 (14.77:1).

tokens.name: bm-text-inv-2
tokens.usage: Fog: secondary text on bm-ink (9.91:1) and bm-ink-2 (8.61:1).

tokens.name: bm-line
tokens.usage: Dividers, borders and table rules on bm-paper. Decorative only (1.25:1): never the only edge of an input or control.

tokens.name: bm-line-ink
tokens.usage: Dividers, borders and table rules on bm-ink. Decorative only (1.38:1).

tokens.name: bm-logo-red
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo file. Reference only, for matching print. Never used in layouts.

tokens.name: bm-logo-blue
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo file. Logo and cube only, never as an accent or background.

tokens.name: bm-gradient-start
tokens.usage: First stop of the red emphasis gradient (bm-gradient-emphasis). Not used on its own.

tokens.name: bm-grid-dot-ink
tokens.usage: Dot-grid dots on bm-ink, lighter end of the range: a quiet full-page background grid.

tokens.name: bm-grid-dot-ink-2
tokens.usage: Dot-grid dots on bm-ink, stronger end of the range: stages, slides, posts and cards (the default grid-dot on Ink).

tokens.name: bm-grid-dot-paper
tokens.usage: Dot-grid dots on bm-paper: #D4D4D4 at 50% opacity.

tokens.name: bm-grid-dot-ink-slide
tokens.usage: Dot-grid dots on bm-ink at presentation scale (1920 × 1080 slides, projectors, big screens): one step brighter than bm-grid-dot-ink-2 so the grid stays visible when projected.

tokens.name: bm-grid-dot-paper-slide
tokens.usage: Dot-grid dots on bm-paper at presentation scale: #D4D4D4 at full strength.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page ground: Ink or Paper. 60% of any layout.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and stat bars. On Paper it equals the ground, so set it apart with a line border.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on ground and surface (Mist on Ink, Graphite on Paper; 14.77:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: leads, card copy, URLs flanked by ticks (Fog on Ink, Slate on Paper; 8.32:1 or more on ground and surface).

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: mono labels, stat captions, table headers, slide footers (6.10:1 on Ink, 5.30:1 on Ink 2, 5.25:1 on Paper).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card borders, table rules. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: eyebrow pill, stat bar outline and dividers, secondary button border. Below 3:1 on its ground (1.80:1 / 1.48:1), so the button label carries the meaning.

tokens.name: ground-2
tokens.usage: Quiet second ground: table header rows and code or spec blocks.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Red marks on the current ground: eyebrow dot, ticks, list dashes, focus outline (Red on Ink 6.19:1 on Ink; Matrix Red 4.09:1 on Paper). About 10% of a layout.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Red-tinted fill: hover behind navigation links, 'Measured' and info badges (text on it stays text or link).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and the text button (7.81:1 on Ink, 7.31:1 on Paper, 6.67:1 on accent-tint).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Small red text and links on ground and surface (6.19:1 on Ink, 5.71:1 on Paper).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Red Fill). One per view. 3.94:1 against bm-ink, 4.83:1 against bm-paper.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover (Red Deep).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action or action-hover fill: white (4.83:1 / 5.71:1).

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Dot-grid dots for the current ground: #2A2D32 on Ink (as on every Ink stage in the guidelines), #D4D4D4 at 50% on Paper. Part of the signature: on every piece, full-bleed.

tokens.name: grid-dot-slide
tokens.usage: Dot-grid dots at presentation scale for the current ground: #34383E on Ink, #D4D4D4 on Paper. Every slide, with grid-pitch-slide and grid-dot-radius-slide.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: "Do" and AAA marks in guidance: text on ok-tint (8.55:1 / 4.71:1). Always with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a "Do" example or an ok badge.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: "Don't" and ✕ marks in guidance: text on bad-tint (7.04:1 / 5.75:1). Always with a word or ✕, never colour alone.

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a "Don't" example or a warning badge.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Inter Tight 600. Sizes are the desktop end of a fluid range; the phone end is in each usage note. Sentence case, one red emphasis word at most.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Designing the future of intelligent infrastructure
styles.usage: Covers, hero lines, big numbers. Fluid 38px (phone) to 68px (desktop).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page and slide titles. Fluid 31px to 48px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Numbers in a stat bar (tabular figures).

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Inter 400 for reading, 500 for UI emphasis. Left-aligned, lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Our diagnostic models help radiologists review scans faster, in 5 partner hospitals.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline. Fluid 17px to 19px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We ship systems that run in hospitals and businesses every day, and we support them around the clock.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, detail lines, metadata. Fluid 13px to 15px.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels: 15px semibold, arrow at the end.

groups.name: Utility
groups.note: JetBrains Mono 500, always set in capitals.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels above blocks, section numbers, table headers. Uppercase, tracking +13%, in text-3.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Text inside the eyebrow pill. Uppercase, tracking +16%.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stat captions and tags on stages. Uppercase, tracking +12%, in text-3.

spacing.note: A 4px system: every gap is a step on this one scale.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Step 1: the tightest gap, e.g. between a tick and its stat.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Step 2: inside eyebrows and between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Step 3: vertical padding in buttons; gaps inside a stat.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Step 4: gaps between related items in a row.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Step 5: card padding; horizontal padding in buttons.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Step 6: space between a headline block and what follows.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Step 7: gaps between stats in a row; between page sections on phone.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Step 8: between page sections.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Step 9: the largest section break.

tokens.name: margin-graphic
tokens.usage: Minimum distance from text to any edge in a graphic, as a share of its width.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Available on the scale.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Available on the scale.

tokens.name: bm-r
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: bm-r-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and stat bars.

tokens.name: bm-r-pill
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and tags.

shadow.note: No drop shadows on cards or the logo. The primary button alone carries a soft red shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button only.

focus.note: Keyboard focus is a solid accent outline (Red on Ink on Ink, Matrix Red on Paper), offset from the control.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Outline width on :focus-visible.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between the control and its outline.

gradient.note: One gradient in the whole brand.

tokens.name: bm-gradient-emphasis
tokens.usage: The red emphasis word only (one per headline). Headline sizes only: its weakest stop is 3.34:1 on either ground.

opacity.note: Strengths for the red glow and for photo overlays.

tokens.name: glow-ink
tokens.usage: Main red glow on Ink (top-right corner). Part of the signature: on every Ink piece, with the dot grid.

tokens.name: glow-paper
tokens.usage: Main red glow on Paper (top-right corner). Part of the signature: on every Paper piece, with the dot grid.

tokens.name: glow-2-ink
tokens.usage: Optional second glow on Ink (bottom-left).

tokens.name: glow-2-paper
tokens.usage: Optional second glow on Paper.

tokens.name: photo-overlay-min
tokens.usage: Lightest Ink overlay on a photo that carries text.

tokens.name: photo-overlay-max
tokens.usage: Strongest Ink overlay on a photo that carries text.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Dot-grid spacing. Always a regular grid, full-bleed, on every piece.

tokens.name: grid-pitch-slide
tokens.usage: Dot-grid spacing at presentation scale: 1920 × 1080 slides and anything seen on a projector or big screen.

tokens.name: grid-dot-radius-slide
tokens.usage: Dot radius at presentation scale (5px dots on a 1920px-wide slide), with grid-pitch-slide.

tokens.name: grid-pitch-small-image
tokens.usage: Dot-grid spacing for images platforms shrink (profile pictures), so dots survive.

tokens.name: grid-dot-radius
tokens.usage: Dot radius in the dot grid.

tokens.name: tick-min
tokens.usage: Shortest red tick.

tokens.name: tick-max
tokens.usage: Longest red tick.

icon.note: Outline icons (the site uses Bootstrap Icons), one set per piece.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Reference icon size.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Outline stroke at 24px, rounded joins.

logo.note: Below these sizes SOLUTIONS fills in: switch to the cube mark instead of shrinking the lockup.

tokens.name: logo-min-lockup
tokens.usage: Smallest lockup width on screen.

tokens.name: logo-min-lockup-print
tokens.usage: Smallest lockup width in print.

tokens.name: logo-min-cube
tokens.usage: Smallest cube mark on screen.

tokens.name: logo-min-cube-print
tokens.usage: Smallest cube mark in print.
